at1708_detection_rule.description: A coopmat binding is loop-carried (phi-eligible) ONLY when: (1) stmt_reassigns_binding_unconditionally returns true (unconditional top-level assign exists), AND (2) stmt_has_conditional_reassign returns false (no conditional if/else reassignment). Two new functions implement the two-gate check. detect_loop_carried_coopmat now returns Result and fires LoopCarriedCoopMatConditionalReassignUnsupported on violation.
at1708_detection_rule.why_uncond_plus_cond_also_rejected: Even when a top-level unconditional assign exists, a conditional reassignment inside the if/else branch causes body emission to update var_ids[acc] to the if-branch SSA id (the if block emits AFTER the top-level assign in the body sequence). The latch_values capture after body emission holds the if-branch SSA id — which does NOT dominate the continue/back-edge block. The resulting OpPhi is invalid SPIR-V. Conservative rejection of both cases is correct.
